parameters.query:
USE TestDB;

SELECT 
    message_id,
    session_id,
    message_type,
    content,
    status_type,
    sql_query,
    metadata,
    data,
    created_at,
    user_id
FROM dbo.chat_messages
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.query.sessionId }}'
  AND (
    user_id = {{ $json.query.userId || 'NULL' }}
    OR user_id IS NULL
  )
ORDER BY message_id ASC;
